settings.text:
§l§6General§r §7------------------------------------------------
§7Update speed §8(lower = more responsive, higher = better performance)
settings.name: qof:INTERVAL_DELAY

settings.text: §7tool durability use by Auto Harvest and sign-unwaxing
settings.name: qof:CONSUME_DURABILITY

settings.text:
§l§6Dynamic Light§r §7------------------------------------------
§7Light up your hand when holding a light source:
settings.name: qof:LIGHT.MODE

settings.text:
§l§6Carry Containers§r §7--------------------------------------
§7Sneak + click a chest or barrel to pick it up and carry it
§7Carrying containers:
settings.name: qof:CARRIED_CHEST.MODE

options.name: no_jump
options.text: On§7, can't jump while carrying §8(still can swim)

settings.text:
§l§6Harden Powder§r §7----------------------------------------
§7Let concrete powder harden when it touches water:
settings.name: qof:WATER_CONCRETE.MODE

settings.text:
§l§6Offhand§r §7------------------------------------------------
§7Double-sneak to swap an item into your offhand. §8(Not supported yet for named, enchanted, or dyed items)
§7Offhand slot:
settings.name: qof:OFFHAND.MODE

settings.text:
§l§6Auto Harvest§r §7------------------------------------------
§7Automatically harvest and replant fully-grown crops:
settings.name: qof:HARVEST.MODE

options.name: consume
options.text: On, consumes a seed per replant

settings.text:
§l§6Cauldrons§r §7---------------------------------------------
§7Allow more items to interact with cauldrons:
settings.name: qof:WATER_CAULDRON.MODE

settings.text: §7Repair anvils with Iron Ingots §8(custom feature, not vanilla)
settings.name: qof:REPAIR_ANVIL.ENABLED

settings.text: §7Open/close both sides of a double door together
settings.name: qof:DOUBLE_DOOR.ENABLED

settings.text: §cDebug mode §8(spammy logs in chat/console, leave off)
settings.name: qof:DEBUG
